description: Scikit-learn provides tools for small machine-learning tasks in Python. Learn features, fitting, predictions and fair checks using tiny data and built-in examples. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
learningObjectives: Practise predict a number with regression

seo.title: Scikit-learn Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Scikit-learn with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
